name: batch
description: Run several independent tool operations in ONE call — multiple searches, multiple file searches/reads, or multiple app/script writes. Every result comes back in a single round-trip, each labeled [n/N]. Prefer this over calling tools one by one whenever you need several operations at once. Sub-calls use the same public tool names and parameters as normal calls. Never nest batch inside batch; keep dependent steps (e.g. write then edit the same file) as separate calls.

calls.description: up to 8 operations, run in order

arguments.description: that tool's parameters, same shape as a normal call

tool.description: public tool name, e.g. search, fetch_url, files, app, scripts, research_lookup, skills

name: skills
description:
Manage Agent Skills from app, project, and user/global roots; create and install write only to the app-managed root.
- action=load: Read full skill instructions or a relative file. Needs name; optional file.
- action=create: Create a skill. Needs name, description; optional body, overwrite.
- action=install: Install a skill from GitHub. Needs source.

file.description: optional path within the skill for load; defaults to SKILL.md

name: scripts
description:
Manage confined space scripts, run skill or space scripts, and install packages.
- action=list: List space script files.
- action=read: Read a script with stable hash-lines. Needs path; optional offset, limit.
- action=write: Replace a script's complete content. Needs path, content.
- action=edit: Apply hash-line edits to a script. Needs path, edits.
- action=run: Run an existing skill or space script. Needs path; optional skill, space, args.
- action=python: Write and run Python in the space environment, persisting unless temporary=true. Needs code, name; optional temporary, args.
- action=install: Install packages into at most one skill or app target, defaulting to the space Python environment. Needs packages; optional skill, app.

edits.description: hash-line edits from the latest read

line.description: optional 1-based line number to disambiguate repeated lines

path.description: script path relative to the scripts dir

skill.description: skill name for run (unless space=true), or pip target for install

space.description: run from the space scripts directory

temporary.description: delete the script after python runs (default false)

name: search
description:
Search the web, scholarly literature, or HN/Reddit discussions.
- mode=web: Search using the configured web backend. Needs query; optional recency, include_domains, exclude_domains.
- mode=academic: Search Semantic Scholar, preserving scholarly metadata. Needs query; optional limit.
- mode=discussion: Search HN and Reddit, preserving engagement metadata. Needs query.

exclude_domains.description: exclude these domains from web results

include_domains.description: restrict web results to these domains

name: fetch_url
description:
Fetch readable, paged text from URLs, PDFs, or YouTube transcripts, using the 24-hour cache and respecting verifier cache-only mode.
- fetch_url: Fetch a page of text. Needs url; optional offset, limit, fresh.

name: media
description:
Generate and transform media, and manage named video image references.
- action=generate_image: Generate an image, optionally using a pasted image reference. Needs prompt; optional image_id, size.
- action=generate_video: Generate a video from text and optional frame or reference images. Needs prompt; optional duration, resolution, aspect_ratio, generate_audio, first_frame_id, last_frame_id, ref_image_id, character_refs, location_refs, seed, source_video_id.
- action=edit: Transform a video locally with ffmpeg. Needs video_id; optional lighting, camera_move, intensity, speed, trim_start, trim_end, remove_audio.
- action=extract_frame: Extract a video frame locally with ffmpeg. Needs video_id; optional time_sec, format.
- action=stitch: Concatenate video clips locally with ffmpeg. Needs video_ids.
- action=save_reference: Save a named image reference for video consistency. Needs name, image_id, description; optional type.
- action=list_references: List saved image references.
- action=delete_reference: Delete a named image reference. Needs name.

aspect_ratio.description: video aspect ratio (default 16:9, normalized per model)

duration.description: video duration in seconds (default 6, normalized per model)

first_frame_id.description: image ID for the first video frame

image_id.description: reference image for generate_image, or image being saved for save_reference

last_frame_id.description: image ID for the last video frame

source_video_id.description: source video ID for provider video continuation
